title: N7 chat-server: should_push
description: kinds AND chatIds, owner-sent, membership, mute/muteUntil with broadcast bypass, is_contact_blocked, capability-less config = absent; D6 snapshot rule documented on should_push. See JMAP-nbk3 design field (approved plan) for scope, acceptance and quoted RFC/draft lines.
notes:
Regression test written: crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/chat_push_should_push.rs (16 tests). Fails at HEAD only on unresolved import should_push. Signature assumed: should_push(b, caller, account_id, cfg, caps: &HashMap<Id, ChatPushCapability>, msg, owner) -> Result<bool, B::Error>; caps added vs plan sketch because 'capability-less config = absent' needs it (mirrors validate_chat_push/chat_state_change_for). Membership: group Chat.members must contain accountId; absent Chat = not member. muteUntil: future = active, past = expired (muted:false in both). push:213 untested per D6. Owner-sent check must precede any sender ChatContact lookup (owner has no ChatContact).
Implemented should_push in crate-jmap-chat-server/src/push.rs (exported from lib.rs); shared is_plaintext helper now used by builder and should_push. Membership: group = Chat.members has accountId; channel = Space.members has accountId (draft-00: channel membership determined by containing Space); direct/other = account holds the Chat. muteUntil: active iff now < muteUntil; unparseable muteUntil or pre-1970 clock = active (fail closed). D6 rule documented on should_push. Gates: fmt, clippy --workspace --tests, test -p jmap-chat-server, test -p jmap-testjig, doc -D warnings all pass. Channel-membership branch has no test (regression suite covers group only).
